note: if you're going to copy/paste this into your own savedEvents.json folder, delete this node first.
instructions1: format of json file looks like this:
instructions2: serverName: the name of your server,
instructions3: role: the name of the role invited to the event,
instructions4: event: the name of the event itself,
instructions5: days: the number of days in advance.
instructions6: create your own file named savedEvents.json, copy this object structure, and put all of your event objects in an unnamed array.
instructions7: reminder should run the number of days before at exactly the hour the event is scheduled for.
